dedupe_keys.name: path loss dataset for fifth generation of wireless communications in indoor

description: The Path Loss Dataset for Fifth Generation of Wireless Communications in Indoor is a public OSF collection by Patricia Perdomo Reyes, Giselle Monserrat Galvan Tejada and Amilcar Meneses Viveros. It supplies measured received power and derived path loss at 3.5 GHz for three indoor environments, together with distance and obstruction information such as walls and columns. Raw and cleaned CSV tables let users compare indoor propagation models against the same observations. Coverage is limited to the experimental sites, not a national radio-network survey. The OSF project was created in March 2025 and updated in December 2025; the public metadata inspected here does not establish the measurement dates or a time-series sampling interval. The project is freely available under CC BY 4.0. Missing raw measurements are marked NP and require explicit treatment. These measurements can calibrate building-scale wireless coverage and deployment simulations, including studies using model-vienna-5g-simulators. That relationship is a potential modelling use, not a verified import interface, and the dataset does not represent dynamic subscriber demand.
